parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
快照策略状态。取值范围：

- ENABLED
- DISABLED

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs update-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id esp-xxx --name xxx --state ENABLED --desc xxx --schedule CronExpression=0_0_0/24_0_0_0 --retain-rule Number=10 TimeInterval=14 TimeUnit=DAYS --special-retain-rules '{"Enabled":false,"Rules":[{"SpecialPeriodUnit":"WEEKS","TimeInterval":30,"TimeUnit":"DAYS"}]}' --cross-region-copy-info '{"Enabled":false,"Regions":[{"RetainDays":7,"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou"}]}' --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --storage-rule EnableImmediateAccess=false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs UpdateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Desc xxx --StorageRule '{"EnableImmediateAccess":false}' --State ENABLED --SpecialRetainRules '{"Enabled":false,"Rules":[{"SpecialPeriodUnit":"WEEKS","TimeInterval":30,"TimeUnit":"DAYS"}]}' --Schedule '{"CronExpression":"0_0_0/24_0_0_0"}' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CrossRegionCopyInfo '{"Enabled":false,"Regions":[{"RetainDays":7,"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou"}]}' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --RetainRule '{"Number":10,"TimeInterval":14,"TimeUnit":"DAYS"}' --PolicyId 'esp-xxx' --Name xxx
